field_evidence.Sprite: Main chooses a sprite bank from this code and adds an animation offset for drawing.
field_evidence.State: Damage writes 3/5; main selects alternate flashing blit while >0 and decrements each rendered frame.
field_evidence.Tick: Used as firing interval/health/elapsed counter by different behavior kinds; no single timer meaning fits.

field_evidence.Y: Current vertical pixel coordinate, used for movement, collision and blitting.

alternatives.evidence: 32-byte record shared by player, enemies, objects and projectiles; d_34EC[1] is the player.

Aux1.evidence: Some enemies decrement Aux1 on damage; platform/object kinds use the same field for other state.

Aux2.evidence: Shared per-kind integer state; no single invariant meaning applies across actor kinds.

DX.evidence: Movement adds/subtracts Speed according to DX=1/-1 and collision code reverses DX.

DY.evidence: Vertical movement state initialized and updated per actor kind, alongside horizontal direction.

Frame.evidence: Main loop increments Frame and selects sprite frames using Frame div 5 or another kind-specific divisor.

Inactive.evidence: Inactive=1 denotes an available actor slot, tested by object/projectile spawning.

Kind.evidence: u1_0837/u1_2f6b dispatch behavior with case statements on Kind.

Limit.evidence: Kind-dependent field: projectile impact and enemy animation/fire timing share this slot.

Marked.evidence: The main loop retires a noninactive actor when Marked is nonzero, then restores its old background.

OldX.evidence: Main loop redraws tiles at OldX before rendering the current actor position.

OldY.evidence: Main loop redraws tiles at OldY before rendering the current actor position.

Speed.evidence: Movement and animation add Speed; projectiles initialize it to 8 and most enemies to 1/2.

Sprite.evidence: Drawing chooses a sprite bank/range from Sprite then adds the animation-frame offset.

State.evidence: Collision code writes 3/5 and the draw loop consumes State as rendering/effect state; exact enum is not established.

Tick.evidence: Kind-dependent field: radar hit points, dynamite countdown and other timers share this slot.

DX.evidence: Movement adds/subtracts Speed according to DX=1/-1 and collision code reverses DX.

Frame.evidence: Main loop increments Frame and selects sprite frames using Frame div 5 or another kind-specific divisor.

Inactive.evidence: Inactive=1 denotes an available actor slot, tested by object/projectile spawning.

Kind.evidence: u1_0837/u1_2f6b dispatch behavior with case statements on Kind.

Limit.evidence: Kind-dependent field: projectile impact and enemy animation/fire timing share this slot.

Marked.evidence: The main loop retires a noninactive actor when Marked is nonzero, then restores its old background.

OldX.evidence: Main loop redraws tiles at OldX before rendering the current actor position.

OldY.evidence: Main loop redraws tiles at OldY before rendering the current actor position.

Speed.evidence: Movement and animation add Speed; projectiles initialize it to 8 and most enemies to 1/2.

Sprite.evidence: Drawing chooses a sprite bank/range from Sprite then adds the animation-frame offset.

State.evidence: Damage writes 3/5; main selects alternate flashing blit while >0 and decrements each rendered frame.

Tick.evidence: Kind-dependent field: radar hit points, dynamite countdown and other timers share this slot.

X.evidence: World-space pixel X is used for collision, tile indexing and drawing.

Y.evidence: World-space pixel Y is used for collision, tile indexing and drawing.

Overlay.evidence: u2 rendering draws this extra tile over the background when present.

Solid.evidence: Movement/collision code treats nonzero Solid as a blocking tile.
